title: In the Legacy's mirror
logline: The Legacy's rear-view mirror with the road behind in it and, in the corner of the glass, an eye and a graying eyebrow. The most of his face the sequence allows: a sliver, in a mirror, watching the road go away.

panels.composition: Close on a station wagon's rear-view mirror: the coastal road receding in it, the faint blue haze, and at the mirror's edge a sliver of the driver — one eye, a graying eyebrow. The windshield beyond, the sea.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, close on a car's rear-view mirror showing a coastal road receding with a faint blue exhaust haze and at the mirror's edge a sliver of the driver's face, one eye and a graying eyebrow, the sea through the windshield beyond, no words
image.notes: One eye. The most face the sequence gives.
